result.feedback: Calculation checked. Correct: logged activity is not demonstrated learning. Different groups, missing follow-up and no comparator prevent a causal conclusion. Composition is observed (20% → 60% novice); the cause and outcome-related selection are not measured. Plausible explanations need not have equal evidence. This is a defensible proposal: define the outcome and comparison, audit all assigned learners and check implementation. No experiment has been executed here. Correct unit and scope: relative percent of a count, not percentage points or within-person improvement.
